description: The global photovoltaic mapping research team publishes polygon samples for validating its 2019–2022 panel maps. Coverage separates a 2019 baseline sample from observations of photovoltaic additions during the following years. The public Zenodo record provides a complete Shapefile component set and is free under CC BY 4.0. Attribute tables distinguish sample properties for assessing mapped installations. These labels can help evaluate asset inventories before they enter capacity or hazard-exposure simulations, alongside the plant-level data-global-power-plant-database. A caveat is that a validation sample is not a complete global installation inventory. Sampling design, label definitions and geographic balance must be examined before transferring an accuracy estimate to a different area or year. The repository description and component filenames were checked; polygon geometries and labels were not downloaded.
